name: After § 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
part_text: 1a. Is concerned that Guinea-Bissau is operating as a narco-state with the systematic infiltration of drug trafficking organisations into political, military and security institutions; considers narco-state dynamics to be the primary driver of Guinea-Bissau’s political crisis and instability;
